tools.name: top_apps
tools.description: The top n consumer AI apps on Ascension. scope "live" is today's blended board (updates daily around 6 AM ET); "week" is the latest frozen week (freezes Thursdays). Returns rank, app, platform, change, date, and each app's ascension.fyi page.

tools.name: app_rank
tools.description: Find an app by name (fuzzy: "gemini", "claude", "chat gpt" all work) and return its rank on the live board and in the latest frozen week, with its ascension.fyi page.

tools.name: movers
tools.description: Apps that climbed, dropped, joined, or left the board. week is "latest" (the newest frozen week vs the week before), a Monday date like "2026-10-19", or "live" (today vs the previous day).
